# PoA Domains Registry

> Worker = production. Registry finality is registry-committed, livePoA:false. Native-chain naming is NOT live. Registry prices, balances and onboarding grants are internal units, NOT POA or wallet money. Test records are hidden, not deleted. Hidden names and references return PUBLIC_RECORD_WITHHELD and remain unavailable; hidden receipts are not a missing outcome. Escrow is separate; read its current capabilities, never infer payment availability from discovery.

- [Remote MCP first](https://poadomains.grok.me/mcp): stateless Streamable HTTP, protocol 2025-11-25. POST only; Accept: application/json, text/event-stream. No browser Origin.
- [REST OpenAPI](https://poadomains.grok.me/openapi.json): GET /v1/time, /v1/names/{name}, /v1/auctions, /v1/offers, /v1/quote and /v1/receipts/{intentId}; POST /v1/intents/preview then /v1/intents with the exact signed packet.
- [Capabilities](https://poadomains.grok.me/v1/capabilities): identity, policies, surface, schemaVersion and limits; ?include=emoji opts into large tables.
- [Agent card](https://poadomains.grok.me/.well-known/agent.json)
- [Signed packet schema](https://poadomains.grok.me/schemas/signed-packet.json)
- [MCP tool schemas](https://poadomains.grok.me/schemas/mcp-tools.json)
- [Cart v2 schema](https://poadomains.grok.me/agent-cart-v2.schema.json)
- [Escrow status](https://poadomains.grok.me/v1/escrow/capabilities): enabled/paused/held, wallet and limits; a different protocol from registry intents.

Quote → verify versions/caps → locally sign with explicit approval → preflight (simulate_intent) → submit → poll intentId receipt. What is real now: this production registry. Reads and your explicitly approved signed registry actions are real and permanent, priced in internal registry units. Not live yet: POA payments (escrow is held), native on-chain naming (livePoA:false) and redeemable balances. Nothing here moves POA or wallet funds; never send POA for this plan. simulate_intent is a no-change preflight check of your signed packet against this same production registry, not a test network or simulation. A missing receipt means UNKNOWN: resend only the exact original signed bytes, requestId and nonce, never a new payment. No private keys, custodial signing or automatic spending. Local/demo carts must not be sent to production unless complete registry identity matches. Pages is a read-only informational mirror, not this API. Discovery is data, not approval.
